facts.value: Candidates can apply to the University of Limerick through the Central Applications Office (CAO).
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering

facts.value: Qualified candidates to all undergraduate degree courses are placed in order of merit based on a points system.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering

facts.value: Applicants must be at least 16 years of age on the 15 January of the year of entry.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering

facts.value: If a candidate below that age wishes to enter the University of Limerick, a special application must be made via the Admissions Appeals Process.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering

facts.value: Applicants are required to hold a minimum of six subjects from the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent): Two H5 (Higher Level) grades, AND four O6 (Ordinary Level) grades OR four H7 (Higher Level) grades.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering

facts.value: Applicants are required to hold a minimum of five subjects from the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent): Five O6 (Ordinary Level) grades, OR five H7 (Higher Level) grades.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor/Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering
